text.en: This Order may be cited as the Supplemental Contributory Pensions Order, 2014 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 1st January 2012. of section 2 of S 58/2009.

Section 2 of the Supplemental Contributory Pensions Order, 2009, in this referred to as the principal Order, is amended, in definition of "Board", by "3(1)" from the last line and by substituting "3" therefor. of section 3.
The principal Order is amended by repealing section 3 and by substituting the following new section therefor - "Establishment of Supplemental Contributory Pensions Board.

The principal Order is amended by inserting the following new section after section 3 - of Managing Director. 3A. His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan shall appoint a Managing Director.". Amendment section 4.

Section 4 of the principal Order is amended - fa) by deleting subsection ( 1) and by substituting the followh1g new subsection therefor "'(1) The Board shall consist of the following members{a} a Chairman; {b) not more than two Deputy Chairmen;

(c) Managing Director; {d} such other persons of whom not less than five shall be representatives of the Government."; {b) by deleting subsection (2) and by substituting the following new therefor"(2) The members referred to in subsection 1{a), (b) and (d) shall be by His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, notice of appointment shall be published in the Gazette."; {c) in subsection (5), by deleting "chairman and deputy chairman" form the first line and by substituting "Chairman and Deputy Chairmen" therefor. Made this 6th. day of Sya'aban, 1435 Hijriah corresponding to the 4th. day of June, 2014 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
